mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate directly reduces the cost of capital for corporations, increasing equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 4.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.5% signals strengthening labor market conditions, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE is below 4.5%, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of declining federal funds rate and falling unemployment rate signals a coordinated monetary and labor market stimulus, which accelerates economic growth and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines and UNRATE falls, or the Rank IC for the interaction term over any 3-year window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, rising housing starts signal strong consumer demand for durable goods, which boosts corporate revenues and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods during late-cycle expansions when HOUST is rising, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts above 1900.0 units signals robust residential construction activity, which increases consumer wealth and spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1900.0, or the Rank IC over any 1-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production above 110.0 index level signals robust manufacturing output, which supports corporate profit growth and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is above 110.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In an inflationary regime, a CPIAUCSL index above 200.0 signals persistent high inflation, which prompts central bank tightening and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 200.0 during inflationary regimes, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in payroll employment and decline in unemployment rate signals a rapidly strengthening labor market, which accelerates consumer spending and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls, or the Rank IC for the interaction term over any 1-year rolling window is less than 0.03.
